description: This file defines classes and structures related to the front panel control in a device, including BlinkInfo, FrontPanelBlinkInfo, frontPanelIndicator enum, and CFrontPanel class with methods for managing front panel LEDs, brightness, and preferences.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Represents blinking information associated with a front panel, including timing and comparison operators.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Manages front panel hardware controls such as LEDs, brightness, and preferences, implemented as a singleton.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CFrontPanel, optionally initialized with a service.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the front panel control operations.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the front panel control operations.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of the front panel.

methods.name: getBrightness
methods.description: Gets the current brightness level.

methods.name: setClockBrightness
methods.description: Sets the clock brightness (if enabled).

methods.name: getClockBrightness
methods.description: Gets the clock brightness (if enabled).

methods.name: powerOffLed
methods.description: Turns off a specified LED indicator.

methods.name: powerOnLed
methods.description: Turns on a specified LED indicator.

methods.name: powerOffAllLed
methods.description: Turns off all LEDs.

methods.name: powerOnAllLed
methods.description: Turns on all LEDs.

methods.name: setPowerStatus
methods.description: Sets the power status.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves current preferences as a JsonObject.

methods.name: setPreferences
methods.description: Sets preferences from a JsonObject.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Sets LED state based on BlinkInfo.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Sets blinking pattern based on JsonObject.

methods.name: loadPreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from storage.

methods.name: stopBlinkTimer
methods.description: Stops the blinking timer.

methods.name: set24HourClock
methods.description: Configures 24-hour clock mode.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if 24-hour clock mode is enabled.

methods.name: onBlinkTimer
methods.description: Handles blink timer events.

methods.name: startBlinkTimer
methods.description: Starts the blink timer with specified repeats.

methods.name: setBlinkLed
methods.description: Sets the LED to blink with specified info.
